title: The Unfairness of Fair Machine Learning: Levelling down and strict egalitarianism by default
reasoning: The paper explicitly centers on moral philosophy and theories of distributive justice (such as egalitarianism, prioritarianism, and sufficientarianism) to critique the ethical implications of 'levelling down' in algorithmic fairness measures. It evaluates the moral and legal justifications for current practices and proposes a new ethics-based 'harms-based framework' for fairness.
